'''Willi Saffch''', along with his sister, [[Kara Saffch|Kara]], piloted the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Night Havok]]''.

==Biogrpahy==
Willi fled his homeworld with his sister Kara at a young age to explore the galaxy. Ten years later, he co-owned the Night Havok and worked alongside Kara on salvage and transport jobs, primarily in the [[Korbin]] system. He frequently handled the ship’s maintenance, often under pressure and with limited resources.

During one mission, after a turbulent hyperspace jump, he reported massive failures including hyperdrive damage, shield loss, and a failing power plant. He identified that the ship had been pulled into the [[Zelos system/Legends|Zelos system]] by an unknown gravitational force, confirming they were effectively stranded.
